\begin{lstlisting}[language=SQL, numbers=left, caption={月度汇总查询}, backgroundcolor=\color[HTML]{FFFFFF}, basicstyle=\ttfamily\small\color[HTML]{24292F}, keywordstyle=\color[HTML]{CF222E}, stringstyle=\color[HTML]{0A3069}, commentstyle=\itshape\color[HTML]{6E7781}, numberstyle=\color[HTML]{0550AE}, showstringspaces=false, breaklines=true, columns=fullflexible, frame=single, framexleftmargin=4pt, rulecolor=\color[HTML]{D0D7DE}]
-- 月度汇总
SELECT t.region, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(t.amount) AS total
FROM orders AS t
WHERE t.created_at >= '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY t.region
ORDER BY total DESC;
\end{lstlisting}
